description.la: Liber primus: vita et virtutes Gertrudis, scripti ab una ex sororibus Helftensibus; commendatio personae, testimonia gratiae, signa caelestia.
description.en-US: Book I, written by a sister of Helfta: the life and virtues of Gertrude, the witnesses of grace and the heavenly signs.
